title: 4-Day Cairo Highlights: Pyramids & Ancient Egypt
metaTitle: Cairo in 4 Days | Pyramids & Ancient Egypt Tour
metaDescription: Discover Cairo and Giza in four days with the Pyramids, Sphinx, museums and ancient sites on a compact tour designed for a short stay in Egypt.
breadcrumb: Explore Our Travel Destinations & Multi-Country Tours
summary:
The 4-Day Cairo City Break Tour concentrates on Cairo and Giza, making it possible to cover several major sites without adding domestic flights or an overnight journey elsewhere in Egypt. Visit the Pyramids of Giza before exploring Saqqara and Memphis, then continue with the Grand Egyptian Museum. The itinerary also reaches Old Cairo, the Citadel and Khan El Khalili Bazaar, bringing different periods of the city’s history into a short stay.
The four-day format can be arranged year-round. Selected 5-star hotels with breakfast, English-speaking local guides, transfers, entrance fees and the scheduled sightseeing are included in the program.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Cairo
itinerary.text:
Arrival at Cairo International Airport. Meet and transfer to your hotel in Cairo.
Hotel check-in after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Sightseing Tour to Pyramids, Sphinx, Sakkara and Memphis
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Visit Memphis, the ancient capital of Egypt, and see the colossal statue of Ramesses II. Continue to Saqqara to visit the famous Step Pyramid of Djoser. Later, explore the Pyramids of Giza built for Cheops, Chephren, and Mycerinus, along with the mysterious Great Sphinx of Giza. Transfer back to the hotel. Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Tour to Citadel and Egyptian Museum
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Visit the Grand Egyptian Museum before continuing to the historic Cairo Citadel and the beautiful Mosque of Muhammad Ali. Explore Old Cairo and visit the Saints Sergius and Bacchus Church and the Hanging Church. Later, enjoy free time at the famous Khan el-Khalili bazaar before returning to the hotel. Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Departure from Cairo
itinerary.text:
After breakfast, check out from the hotel before 12:00 pm.
Transfer to Cairo Airport according to your flight departure time.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 4-Day Cairo City Break – Pyramids & Museum?
faqs.a: The 4-Day Cairo City Break focuses on Cairo, Egypt's vibrant capital city. You will discover the world-famous Pyramids of Giza, the Great Sphinx, the Egyptian Museum, and other cultural and historical attractions that showcase the rich heritage of ancient and modern Egypt. The tour runs for 3 nights and 4 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 4-Day Cairo City Break – Pyramids & Museum cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €795 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes hotel accommodation, guided sightseeing tours, entrance fees according to the itinerary, selected meals, and airport and hotel transfers. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates and hotel category.

faqs.q: Are domestic flights included in the package?
faqs.a: No, domestic flights are not included in this package. Since the tour is based entirely in Cairo, no internal flights are required during the itinerary.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes 3 nights of accommodation in a carefully selected Cairo hotel with daily breakfast. Hotels are chosen for their comfort, service quality, and convenient access to the city's major attractions.

faqs.q: Does the Cairo City Break include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking or Spanish-speaking Egyptologist guides accompany the scheduled sightseeing tours. Your guide will provide fascinating insights into Egypt's ancient history, culture, and archaeology.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Egypt?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors with limited time. It covers Egypt's most iconic landmarks and provides an excellent introduction to the country's history and culture within a short itinerary.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is easy. Travelers should be comfortable walking through museums, archaeological sites, and historical attractions. Most visitors of all ages and fitness levels can comfortably participate.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of the Cairo City Break?
faqs.a: Highlights include the Pyramids of Giza, the Great Sphinx, the Egyptian Museum, and the opportunity to experience Cairo's vibrant atmosphere, local culture, and fascinating blend of ancient and modern history.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the 4-Day Cairo City Break – Pyramids & Museum?
faqs.a: You can generally cancel free of charge up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within the applicable cancellation period may be subject to fees according to the booking terms and cancellation policy.

faqs.q: Can the 4-Day Cairo City Break – Pyramids & Museum be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour can be customized according to your preferences. You can add extra nights, include additional sightseeing such as Alexandria, Saqqara, or the Grand Egyptian Museum, upgrade hotel categories, or extend your stay to other destinations in Egypt. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
